content.short: BR1: INFINITE is the world's first risk-based shooter where players pay to spawn and kill to earn.
content.description: BR1: INFINITE links gaming with financial empowerment by turning skill into earnings. Many players devote hours to refining their abilities with limited tangible rewards. This platform seeks to transform that effort into a viable income stream by enabling players to leverage their skills for personal gain. By blending gameplay across Solana, Polygon, BNB Chain, and Ethereum, BR1: INFINITE redefines how gamers experience their passion and convert mastery into measurable rewards.
content.meta: BR1: INFINITE is a decentralized game linking gaming with financial empowerment. Discover BR1: INFINITE and other Decentralized Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
